title: Multivariate Scientific Data Compression with Learned Cross-Variable Latent Decorrelation and Autoregressive Entropy Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.30262v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific simulations generate collections of physical fields with heterogeneous statistics and dependencies, yet learned compressors often encode those fields independently or rely on a shared encoder without explicitly modeling the structure that remains in latent space. We present CAESAR-LDAR, an error-controlled multivariate learned compressor that augments a shared CAESAR-V backbone with two complementary mechanisms: a trainable orthogonal transform that reorganizes dependence across aligned latent channels, and a causal autoregressive hierarchical prior that captures local spatial structure left after transformation. Orthogonality is maintained through a matrix-exponential parameterization, making the transform exactly invertible without an additional penalty. A common residual-correction stage is applied uniformly to all variants to enforce the requested reconstruction tolerance.   Experiments across combustion, climate, and turb

translated_title: 基于学习的跨变量潜在去相关与自回归熵建模的多变量科学数据压缩
translated_abstract: 科学模拟会生成具有异构统计特性和相互依赖关系的物理场集合，然而现有的学习型压缩器通常独立地编码这些场，或者依赖共享编码器而不显式建模潜在空间中残留的结构。我们提出CAESAR-LDAR，一种误差可控的多变量学习型压缩器，它在共享的CAESAR-V骨干网络上增加了两种互补机制：一个可训练的正交变换，用于重新组织对齐潜在通道之间的依赖关系；以及一个因果自回归分层先验，用于捕获变换后残留的局部空间结构。正交性通过矩阵指数参数化来保持，使该变换无需额外的惩罚项即可实现精确可逆。所有变体统一应用一个通用的残差校正阶段，以满足所要求的重建容差。在燃烧、气候和湍流等数据集上的实验……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出CAESAR-LDAR误差可控多变量科学数据压缩器，通过矩阵指数参数化的可训练正交变换实现跨变量潜在去相关，并结合因果自回归分层先验捕获残留空间结构，显著提升多变量科学数据的压缩效果。
